purpose: Teach: ドキュメント/ゴム/サム/回想/カタカナ/方言/弓/虎

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文芸部、ドキュメント映像コンクール、応募するんだ。
lines.en: The literary club is entering a documentary video contest.
lines.style: Opening bright and direct. Quick, eager pace. Slight lift at the end — inviting reaction. Natural speech tempo, not rushed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。撮影用のゴムバンド、機材で要るんでしょ。
lines.en: That's cool. You'll need rubber bands and gear for the equipment, right?
lines.style: Soft, conversational. Thinking-out-loud quality — genuinely processing. Steady pace, no rush. Ends with the question mark as genuine curiosity, not challenge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 担当の留学生サム、編集ソフト得意なの。
lines.en: Sam — the exchange student on the team — is really good at editing.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Warm when naming Sam. Slight emphasis on 'really good'. Speaking a little faster than usual, genuine enthusiasm without performing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 去年の回想シーン、面白かったよな。
lines.en: The flashback scenes from last year were actually pretty fun.
lines.style: Nostalgic lean. Slower, more reflective pace. Settles into the memory. Small smile underneath the words. Not wistful — genuine appreciation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 字幕、カタカナ用語も多くて、丁寧にしたい。
lines.en: The subtitles have a lot of katakana terms in them — I want to get that right.
lines.style: Thoughtful, focused. Slight pause before the second half. Careful enunciation. Shows she's thinking through the details. Not anxious — meticulous.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 方言の話者にインタビュー、地元で出来そうだな。
lines.en: We could probably do interviews with dialect speakers right here in town.
lines.style: Practical, problem-solving tone. Building on his idea. Slightly faster pace, seeing possibility. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive — genuinely working through logistics.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 弓道部の道場も、撮影候補。
lines.en: The kyudo dojo could work as a filming location too.
lines.style: Cheerful, visibly thinking of new angles. Opening bright. Pace picks up slightly. The 'too' carries a sense of gathering options — optimistic momentum.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: タイガースのファン、虎の旗も出してる店、面白い。
lines.en: The Tigers fans around here actually put tiger flags in their shop windows — pretty funny.
lines.style: Dry observation with warmth underneath. Slight wry smile in the voice. Measured pace. Noticing the small, specific detail that makes something charming. Ends with genuine amusement, not sarcasm.
